newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil to reveal monetary base/debt data next week.
newsitem.headline: Brazil to reveal monetary base/debt data next week.

text.p: Brazil's Central Bank expects to release monetary base data for August and estimated public sector debt figures for July next week, a spokesman said.
According to daily averages, the monetary base expanded 1.4 percent in July.

In June, estimated total net public sector debt stood at 241,457 billion reais, or 33.9 percent of gross domestic product. Net internal debt was 210.722 billion reais or 29.6 percent of GDP, while net external debt was 30.735 billion reais or 4.3 percent of GDP.
